practiceReport.name: Adam Butler
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Butler enterted the NFL's concussion protocol after being ruled out for the remainder of the Raiders' Week 11 loss to the Broncos. The defensive tackle will need to be cleared by an independent neurologist to return to full-contact practice.

practiceReport.name: Tim Keenan III
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Keenan went down with a knee injury in the first half, and he will now officially be sidelined for the rest of Week 11. With Adam Butler (concussion) also done for the day, JJ Pegues will handle the bulk of the workload at defensive tackle versus the Broncos.

practiceReport.name: Tonka Hemingway
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Returned to Limited Participation (LP) on Wednesday following prior-game absence
practiceReport.beatComment: Hemingway did not play in the Raiders' Week 11 loss to the Broncos due to a stinger injury. The defensive lineman has continued to suffer the stingers affects in Week 12 prep, but has upgraded to a limited participant. Hemingway will likely need to upgrade to a full participant by Friday's practice for the chance to avoid any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.

practiceReport.name: Brock Bowers
practiceReport.archetypeNote: High-snap focal-point tight end with high active conversion on minor mid-week tags.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 90%
Beat/podium consensus (coaching staff report): on track to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: Bowers was sidelined for this past Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos, but he's now practiced in a limited fashion in each of the Raiders' last three sessions. Though the Raiders have a bye looming in Week 13 that would give Bowers more time to recover from his lower-body injuries, Kubiak indicated that the break in the schedule won't be a factor in Bowers' status for this Sunday's matchup with the Browns, per Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com. Still, Bowers may need to advance to full practice participation by Friday in order to gain clearance for the Week 12 game.

practiceReport.name: Michael Mayer
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (79% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Mayer missed out on a prime opportunity with top TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) inactive in Week 11. When Bowers was out in Weeks 1 and 2 as he recovered from a meniscus trim in his left knee, Mayer went for a combined 9-55-0 line on 11 targets in those contests, but the latter also missed a stretch in the fourth quarter this Sunday due to a back injury. Bowers' status will be worth monitoring this week, as an absence from him next Sunday in Cleveland will set up Mayer for another key chance to produce.

practiceReport.name: Dareke Young
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Young was diagnosed with a stinger in the first half of the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos and did not return. However, his ability to practice in full Wednesday indicates that the fifth-year wide receiver will be available for Sunday's road game against the Browns. Young has mostly operated on special teams this season and has not been targeted in the passing game since Week 4 against the Chiefs.

practiceReport.name: JJ Pegues
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Pegues exited the Raiders' Week 11 loss to the Broncos late in the fourth quarter and did not return to the contest. The defensive tackle's full participation and injury clearance in the first prep session of Week 12 imply Pegues did not return to the Week 11 loss because he exited too late, when the game was out of reach.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Patrick Johnson
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Johnson was a full participant in Wednesday's practice in what was his first on-field action since being placed on injured reserve in late October due to a neck injury. His ability to practice in full is an encouraging sign, but Johnson would need to be activated from injured reserve in order to be available for Sunday's game against the Browns.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Brennan Jackson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Chigozie Anusiem
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Anusiem will be forced to miss the entire upcoming season after suffering a knee injury during Thursday's preseason game versus the Texans. The 25-year-old will now shift his focus to getting healthy for the 2027 campaign.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Justin Pickett
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Undisclosed) on Aug 13, 2026; ineligible to return in 2026 under NFL CBA rules.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Keyron Crawford
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Crawford was not given a tag that designated his return during 2026, meaning the rookie third-rounder will spend the entirety of his first season on IR. The linebacker will need to look toward 2027 to make his NFL debut. With Crawford out, Malcolm Koonce becomes the primary depth option at outside linebacker behind Kwity Paye and Maxx Crosby.
